zh-Hans.description: 灵可时刻（Linko Moment）用于记录日常、分享活动和管理家庭协作。可在圈子中交流，记录与查看照片和动态，维护家庭成员、奖励规则及积分账本，并使用运动栏目记录训练与公里数。支持 iPhone 原生操作、系统分享入口，以及可选的 Apple Watch 配套功能。请使用测试内容，避免上传不必要的个人资料；通过 TestFlight 提交问题、复现步骤和截图。
zh-Hans.whatToTest: 请重点测试：1. 用户中心登录、退出及原账号访问；2. 圈子、活动、动态和照片的查看与管理；3. 系统分享入口向活动添加内容；4. 家庭成员、奖励规则、积分账本和历史记录；5. 运动记录、暂停/继续、完成后查看及公里数统计；6. 中文/英文名称和当地时间显示；7. 有 Apple Watch 时验证配套入口，没有手表也可完成 iPhone 流程。旧版名称改为 LinkoXMoment；新版中文名为“灵可时刻”。请使用测试数据，不进行真实支付。

en-US.description: Linko Moment brings everyday moments, activity sharing and family collaboration together. Browse and manage circles, activities, photos and posts; maintain family members, reward rules and points history; and record exercise sessions and distance. The iPhone app includes a system share extension and optional companion Apple Watch features. Use test content and avoid unnecessary personal data. Report reproducible issues through TestFlight with steps and screenshots.
en-US.whatToTest: Test User Center sign-in/sign-out and access with an existing account; circles, activities, posts and photos; adding content through the system share extension; family members, reward rules and points history; exercise pause/resume/completion and distance totals; local-time display and English/Chinese app names. Apple Watch checks are optional; review can be completed on iPhone. The legacy app is named LinkoXMoment; the successor is Linko Moment (灵可时刻). Use test data and do not make real payments.

reviewNotes:
Use the existing shared User Center review login supplied in the review login fields. No SMS, personal registration, Apple Watch hardware or purchase is required for the iPhone review flow. Open the app, sign in, and review circles/activities, the family reward and points pages, and Exercise. Exercise supports starting a session, pausing/resuming and viewing completed records; distance is a training record and is not a medical measurement. The system share extension is available from the iOS share sheet. Use test content only.

Migration explanation: net.impx.happylife.parent is our existing app and its name is now LinkoXMoment. net.impx.happylife is the successor, named Linko Moment / 灵可时刻. Existing User Center accounts and server-side services remain usable without a migration fee or mandatory repurchase. Local-only data remain in the respective app sandbox. The old app remains available during migration and will not be removed before the successor is publicly available and service continuity is verified.

storeWhatsNew.zh-Hans: 旧版名称更新为 LinkoXMoment，并同步当前最新的圈子活动、照片分享、家庭积分和运动记录功能。支持训练暂停/继续、完成记录和公里数统计。原账号及原应用数据继续保留；新版应用中文名为“灵可时刻”。
storeWhatsNew.en-US: Renames the legacy app to LinkoXMoment and includes the current circles, activity/photo sharing, family points and exercise features. Exercise supports pause/resume, completed records and distance totals. Existing accounts and data in this app are retained. The successor is Linko Moment (灵可时刻).
